title: admission-status.test.ts runRecord tests are timing-racy: the admitted test fails ~5/13 solo runs, and both the admitted and lobby tests fail in the full meeting-bot suite
evidence: solo runs of admission-status.test.ts: 5 of 13 had pass 3 fail 1 (admitted test, line 88, states=recording: the wait-hook sampler never observed starting before recording). Full suite (69 files): lobby test and admitted test both failed at about 10.3 s. Diagnostic copy with timestamps: the first status sample in the admitted test often arrives after admitted already flipped it. Maker ran only 3 solo runs, all green. The product code (tab-browser.ts line 182 and 225, record-commands.ts, admission-gate.ts) read correct and mutants M1-M3 were killed; the defect is the proof, not the fix.
fix_direction: sample the status file on an independent setInterval (10 ms) started before runRecord, or hold the fake bot at the lobby until the test has observed starting (barrier file or stdin), so no assertion depends on controller poll timing; re-run solo 20x and in the full suite 5x.
